sources.table_name: CPS annual averages, Table 11 · Employed people by detailed occupation, sex, race, and Hispanic or Latino ethnicity · 2025
sources.definition: The CPS reports the percentages of all workers in each occupation who are women and who are Black or African American in separate columns. It does not report Black men or Black women separately for each detailed occupation.
sources.locator: Annual averages; percent of total employed columns. Context only.
